aiStudio.metaDescription: A separate, privacy-first workspace for practical creator utilities built into CreatorAI Hub.
aiStudio.kicker: CreatorAI Hub / Native workspace · free launch access
aiStudio.heroText: AI Studio is a separate workspace for practical creator utilities — briefs, prompts, calendars, and local media tasks. No tool rankings. No hidden uploads.
aiStudio.sectionText: The Directory helps you evaluate external tools. AI Studio will help you produce ready-to-use outputs directly in your browser.
aiStudio.principle1Text: Directory is for discovering and comparing external products. Studio is for making useful outputs.
aiStudio.principle2Text: File-based utilities are designed to process in the browser. Your media is not a Studio upload queue.
aiStudio.principle3Text: Each utility will say exactly what it does. No implied live research, model access, or background processing.
aiStudio.externalCta: Need to choose an external AI tool first?
aiStudio.externalText: That belongs in the Directory — with sources, pricing status, and comparisons kept separate from this workspace.
aiStudio.utilityPromptBuilderText: Structure a prompt for an image, video, script, avatar, or B-roll.
aiStudio.utilityThumbnailBriefText: Turn a video idea into a clear brief for a designer or image model.
aiStudio.utilityThumbnailTextText: Generate concise, readable thumbnail-copy options without misleading claims.
aiStudio.utilityContentCalendarText: Build an editable publishing plan around your niche and content pillars.
aiStudio.utilityImageToolsText: Resize, crop, convert, compress, and inspect images locally.
aiStudio.utilitySubtitleToolsText: Clean SRT files, validate timing, and convert between SRT and VTT.
aiStudio.utilityAudioTrimmerText: Trim a local audio clip with a simple waveform and browser preview.
aiStudio.utilityVideoInspectorText: Read local video metadata and check target-platform fit before publishing.
aiStudio.pbMetaDesc: Build structured creator prompts locally in your browser.
aiStudio.pbDesc: Turn a clear creative brief into short, standard, detailed, and negative prompts. The rule-based generator stays in your browser.
aiStudio.tbMetaDesc: Create a clear, truthful thumbnail design brief locally.
aiStudio.tbDesc: Make a concise, mobile-aware brief for a designer, Canva, or an image model. This creates direction — not an image.
aiStudio.ttMetaDesc: Generate concise thumbnail text options in your browser.
aiStudio.ttDesc: Generate 15 concise options across useful angles. The templates keep to your word limit and do not invent outcomes or clickbait claims.
aiStudio.ccMetaDesc: Build an editable creator content calendar and export it to CSV.
aiStudio.ccDesc: Build an editable 7, 14, or 30-day calendar around your niche and goals; then copy or download it as CSV. It does not claim live trend research.
aiStudio.stMetaDesc: Clean, convert, and validate SRT and VTT captions locally.
aiStudio.stDesc: Clean an existing subtitle file, convert SRT and VTT, or inspect timing and line length. No transcription is claimed or sent to a server.
aiStudio.itMetaDesc: Resize, crop, convert, and inspect images locally in your browser.
aiStudio.itDesc: Inspect, resize, centre-crop, convert, and export images inside your browser. Your image never enters an upload queue.
aiStudio.atMetaDesc: Preview and trim local audio files to a downloadable WAV.
aiStudio.atDesc: Read a local audio file, choose an in/out range, preview the selection, and download a WAV trim. Processing stays in your browser.
aiStudio.viMetaDesc: Inspect local video metadata and extract poster frames in your browser.
aiStudio.viDesc: Read dimensions, duration, and aspect ratio; check simple platform fit; and extract a poster frame without uploading your video.
aiStudio.upSubtitle: The native workspace is free for launch. Paid plans arrive later — nothing here is for sale yet.
